en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The owner of the bounties, it is Obligated upon him that he extends upon his dependants’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A wealthy person should improve the quality of life of his family.’”
